reviewed_by: Claude general-purpose subagent, blind judgment reviewer, wide-packet re-review batch 0, 2026-08-01

samples_reviewed.question_text: What time does the clock show?
What time does the clock show?
What time does the clock show?
What time does the clock show?

competency_fulfillment.rationale: The competency requires reading and writing time 'by the hour, half hour, AND quarter hour', but every single one of the five samples uses only on-the-hour times, 11:00, 1:00, 7:00, 5:00, 2:00 across seeds 42-46 -- no half-hour or quarter-hour time appears anywhere in the sample set.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Half-hour and quarter-hour, both explicitly named sub-cases, are completely absent across all five seeds; only whole-hour reading, seeds 42, 43, 45, 46, and whole-hour writing, seed 44's 'Set the clock to show 7:00', are ever generated.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Both the read prompt 'What time does the clock show?' and the write prompt 'Set the clock to show 7:00.' are short, direct, and appropriate for Grade 1 Quarter 4.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Both read, 4 of 5 samples, and write, seed 44, directions appear, which is good directional coverage, but with no half-hour or quarter-hour variant to pair with either direction, the variant space only spans one of the three named time granularities.

competency_alignment.rationale: All variation across the five seeds is in which whole hour is displayed, 11, 1, 7, 5, 2, which only exercises the 'hour' portion of the named scale and never touches the half-hour or quarter-hour distinctions the competency explicitly calls out.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: The competency's stated scope spans three time granularities, hour, half hour, quarter hour; the observed sample range covers only whole hours, missing two-thirds of the named granularity scale entirely.
